section: A Canadian at the Springfield gym
sentence: (Press coverage noted that Donald MacLennan Barton had brought the game to Toronto’s YMCAs from the Chicago branch in 1892.) In 1936 Naismith was thrilled to be sent to the Olympics in Berlin, where he watched the United States defeat Canada 19 to 8 to win the first gold medal in basketball.
